description: This image helps the reader understand that each zero of a deformed monotone Hurwitz polynomial approaches its limit from a definite side as the genus grows: for the 4-cycle the smallest zero climbs towards −2 from below, and up to ten items only 8 of 132 cycle types ever move the wrong way.
head: Hurwitz zeros: which way they move
sub: For the 4-cycle the smallest zero goes −2.618, −2.215, −2.086, −2.036 at genus 0 to 3, approaching −2 from below.
